content: Accessibility for image-heavy sites (W3C WAI + WCAG 2.2): informative images need short alt describing essential info; decorative images need alt="" (never omit the attribute); functional images (linked covers) describe the destination/action, not the look; cap alt ~150 chars, no 'image of'. Text over images needs 4.5:1 contrast (3:1 large text) - use a semi-transparent scrim overlay. WCAG 2.2 new SC 2.5.8 Target Size Minimum: 24x24 CSS px pointer targets. Lightbox/modal should move focus and support Esc.
